cause: Autoconf installation-prefix strings embed absolute rules_foreign_cc sandbox paths in NGSPICEBINDIR/NGSPICEDATADIR. SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and compiler file-prefix mapping do not normalize those configured literal strings.
comparison_scope: All original binary waveform payload bytes (header dates excluded), derived metrics, spectra and frozen qualification checks. CPU timing, OS resource usage and timestamp-bearing headers are not claimed identical.

historical_recovery.method: Equal-length replacement of only the two observed install-prefix sandbox-number strings in the preserved exploratory binary. Candidate accepted only when complete SHA256 equals retained metadata.

initial_post_rebuild_artifact_recheck.reason: ngspice_sha256 differed from both retained metadata records

limits: Bit-identical rebuilding of the reference executable remains unsupported by the current absolute-prefix build packaging.
Exact historical recovery is a full-hash identity result, not a general executable-equivalence argument.
ELF/disassembly normalization is descriptive; the fresh30-job comparison establishes numerical reproduction only for the frozen qualification workload.
Retained timings belong to the recorded historical executable; diagnostic timing is not a third performance sample.
Hashes and local process observations are not independent execution attestation.
